effects.rationale: The option directly restricts access to childcare by penalizing parents who are delinquent in child support payments. This implies a restriction on public provision of childcare services.

evidence_quote: Deny or suspend state-issued permits and licenses to parents who are delinquent in paying court-ordered child support.
